description: Outdoor apparel shop: sticky header, split hero with CSS-background visual, 4-up product grid with price and CTA.

referenceProfile.thesis: Commerce clarity: monochrome UI chrome keeps attention on product photography surfaces, and every card repeats the same photo-info-price-action sequence.
signatureMoves: Outline buttons invert to solid black on hover as the single interaction flourish.
A thin dark promo strip frames the page without competing with products.
transferPreserve: Keep product cards in a strict grid with identical internal order: photo, name, price, action.
transferAvoid: Do not add colored badges, rounded playful shapes, or illustration-style surfaces.
